name: asks for a bank account when money is ready but no payout account exists
fullName: useMyActivity — header strip and attention asks for a bank account when money is ready but no payout account exists
description:
My Activity hub: who sees which tab, the header strip, the "add a bank" prompt,
and where each row in the payment history goes. Every request is skipped for
guests and every seller request for non-sellers.
